Senior Backend Infrastructure Engineer at Stripe
Location: San Francisco, CA

Job Description:
We are seeking a Senior Backend Infrastructure Engineer to scale our core event streaming and transaction ingest platform.
You will write high-throughput Go microservices, design partition keys for Kafka topics, and maintain database shard consistency.

Requirements:
- Strong background with Go and distributed systems
- Production experience running Kafka pipelines at high event throughput
- Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and multi-region replication
